{{Top|leg}}
The '''M-S7 seismic mine''' was a [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The M-S7 mine detonated when enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]] entered a relatively small proximity radius, but the payload of the mines was capable of inflicting significant damage to enemy hulls.
